The '''Venedlia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Instrop sector/Legends|Instrop sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was home to the [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Venedlian sandmole]]s.<ref name="SlaveShip" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Venedlia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]]. The book placed the system in grid square M-20<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the work initially further established it as part of the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]], while a "Vendlia" system was placed in grid square S-16 as part of the Instrop [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> However, the "Vendlia" entry was later judged to have been erroneous,<ref name="JCF">{{JCFcite|url=posts/31300956|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfry]]|date=2010-10-09|time=9:19 AM|accessdate=2025-08-06|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20250806163330/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-154#post-31300956|quote= Senator, you may be working from an old Atlas companion -- Vendlia got zapped a while ago for the reason you note, and doesn't appear in the latest one.}} {{C|in response to "Vendlia and Venedlia in Atlas Companion Index are listed separately and in separate sectors nonetheless...despite the fact they are both based on a single reference (Venedlian sandmoles, Slave Ship)...Venedlia is the correct spelling; Vendlia should be torpedoed"}}</ref> and the two entries were merged, with the Venedlia system instead being placed in the Instrop sector in grid square S-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
